brief:
Extreme heat is gripping Gaza Strip on Tuesday, with temperatures climbing above their annual average for this period, the Shehab Wire reported. The meteorological forecasts indicate conditions more severe than typical for the season.

Humidity levels are expected to rise across most areas of the territory. The combination of high temperatures and elevated moisture will intensify the heat stress felt by residents throughout the enclave.
